user.title: 1/5 Load
user.description: Select the switch to control and enter the typical power draw of the load. Use a virtual switch if you want to test the logic first.

runtime.title: 2/5 Runtime
runtime.description: Define the daily minimum runtime, the allowed time window, and the anti-cycling timers. These settings decide how urgently the load must still run later in the day.

data_description.min_daily_runtime_minutes: Guaranteed runtime target for the day. If solar is not enough, Low mode can still force this later.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Prevents rapid off/on switching after the load has started.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Prevents immediate restarts after the load has stopped.

energy.title: 3/5 Grid and Forecast
energy.description: Connect the live grid sensors and the solar forecast. This page decides when the day is treated as Low or High and how much grid import is tolerated in Low mode.

data_description.grid_import_limit_w: Maximum grid import allowed in Low mode before the load is blocked or stopped. High mode uses a much stricter import rule.
data_description.forecast_high_threshold_kwh_per_kwp: If today's forecast per kWp reaches this value, the day is treated as High mode.
data_description.forecast_next_hour_sensor: Improves short-term decisions such as waiting or restarting later in the day.
data_description.forecast_remaining_today_sensor: Improves calculations for how much energy is still expected for the rest of the day.

battery.title: 4/5 Battery
battery.description: Battery inputs are optional but improve decisions. Capacity and SOC are used to estimate whether the remaining forecast can still fill the battery later in the day.

data_description.battery_power_direction: Set how the raw battery power sensor behaves. The integration normalizes it so positive means charging internally.
data_description.battery_mode: Choose whether the controller should protect the battery more conservatively or actively use it when needed.
data_description.min_battery_soc: In Use mode, the controller will avoid forced battery use below this SOC threshold.
data_description.high_mode_base_household_load_w: Used only after the daily minimum runtime is already reached on High days. This is the expected ongoing household base load that should still be reserved from the remaining forecast before optional load runtime is allowed.
data_description.high_mode_household_reserve_margin_perce: Extra safety margin added on top of the household base load to cover variable late-day loads.

advanced.title: 5/5 Diagnostics and Fallback
advanced.description: Enable debug output only for troubleshooting. The Low-mode runtime override is the fallback that still guarantees runtime even if the normal grid limit would otherwise block the load.

data.min_runtime_grid_override: Low minimum runtime may exceed grid limit

data_description.debug_sensor_enabled: Creates the decision debug sensor and writes one JSONL line for every changed decision to /config/solar_load_controller_decisions.jsonl. The exact path is shown on the debug sensor in the debug_log.path attribute. Retention: 7 days or 2000 entries.
data_description.min_runtime_grid_override: If enabled, Low mode may still run the load to reach the daily minimum runtime even when the normal Low-mode grid limit would block the start.
